answer: Require every agent to lock a stake in the umber soil of the shared ledger before it can trade, and let reputation grow back only as slowly as yarrow after a cut: good work earns small increments, fraud slashes the stake at once. Peers then whisper their local trust scores through a gossip protocol, so a sybil swarm that has never done honest work cannot borrow credibility from strangers. Costly to enter, slow to rebuild, impossible to fake at scale.
